prov:action:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/hh_rutas_pie_osm/download -p /data/hh_rutas_pie_osm/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/hh_rutas_pie_osm
cd /data/hh_rutas_pie_osm

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
curl -o download/hh_rutas_pie_osm.osm 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter?data=%28nwr%5B%22highway%22=%22path%22%5D%28-10.7,-77.33,-9.8,-76.55%29;nwr%5B%22highway%22=%22footway%22%5D%5B%22footway%22=%22trail%22%5D%28-10.7,-77.33,-9.8,-76.55%29;nwr%5B%22route%22=%22hiking%22%5D%28-10.7,-77.33,-9.8,-76.55%29;%29;%28._;>;%29;out;' 2>&1

# load into postGIS with:
ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/hh_rutas_pie_osm.osm
echo success: hh_rutas_pie_osm.osm loaded with ogr2ogr


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# Select proper geometry into the named table
psql -d $POSTGRES_DB -U $POSTGRES_USER -p $POSTGRES_PORT -h gaia-db -c "
SELECT * INTO hh_rutas_pie_osm FROM lines;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS lines;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS multilinestrings;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS multipolygons;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS other_relations;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS points;"

# remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
UPDATE hh_rutas_pie_osm
  SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));

# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE hh_rutas_pie_osm DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'hh_rutas_pie_osm',
  'geom_local', 5387, 'multilinestring', 2
);
UPDATE hh_rutas_pie_osm
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),5387)));
CREATE INDEX hh_rutas_pie_osm_geom_local_idx
  ON hh_rutas_pie_osm
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
# Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
cd /data/hh_rutas_pie_osm/
mkdir -p derived

# Create shapefile of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
ogr2ogr -f "ESRI Shapefile" -overwrite derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.shp PG:"<postgres connection>" hh_rutas_pie_osm

# Create downloadable tarfile of shp in derivative directory on osgeo
rm -f derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.shp.tar.gz
tar -czf derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.shp.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_rutas_pie_osm.json -C derived hh_rutas_pie_osm.shp hh_rutas_pie_osm.prj hh_rutas_pie_osm.shx hh_rutas_pie_osm.dbf

# Create gpkg of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
rm -f derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.gpkg
ogr2ogr -f GPKG -overwrite derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.gpkg PG:"<postgres connection>" -select "osm_id,name,highway,other_tags,geom" hh_rutas_pie_osm

# Create downloadable tarfile of gpkg in derivative directory on osgeo
rm -f derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.gpkg.tar.gz
tar -czf derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.gpkg.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_rutas_pie_osm.json -C derived hh_rutas_pie_osm.gpkg

# Create geojson of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
rm -f derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.json
ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON -overwrite derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.json PG:"<postgres connection>" -select "osm_id,name,highway,other_tags,geom" hh_rutas_pie_osm

# Create downloadable tarfile of geojson in derivative directory on osgeo
rm -f derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.geojson.tar.gz
tar -czf derived/hh_rutas_pie_osm.geojson.tar.gz meta_dcat_hh_rutas_pie_osm.json -C derived hh_rutas_pie_osm.json

# Move into correct directory
cd /data/hh_rutas_pie_osm/
